name: DEV-001 - Digital Ocean DOKS Cluster Provisioning
Description:
Provision Digital Ocean Kubernetes (DOKS) clusters for Staging and Production environments. Expectation: Fully functional K8s cluster ready for deployments.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Terraform scripts created to provision DOKS clusters
- Node pools configured with auto-scaling enabled (min 3 nodes, max 10 nodes)
- Digital Ocean Load Balancers attached to the cluster ingress controller

name: DEV-002 - Managed Database & Redis Setup
Description:
Provision Digital Ocean Managed PostgreSQL 16+ and Managed Redis clusters. Expectation: Secure, highly available data layer.

Acceptance Criteria:
- PostgreSQL primary instance deployed with a standby read-replica
- Redis cluster deployed for session state and WebRTC signaling
- Automated daily backups configured with 30-day retention
- VPC peering configured so DBs are only accessible from the DOKS cluster

name: DEV-003 - Cloudflare WAF & DNS Configuration
Description:
Configure Cloudflare for DNS management, CDN caching, and Web Application Firewall (Volume 10). Expectation: Secure edge network.

Acceptance Criteria:
- DNS records point to Digital Ocean Load Balancers (Proxy enabled)
- Cloudflare WAF rules enabled for SQLi, XSS, and known exploit payloads
- Cloudflare CDN configured to cache static frontend assets aggressively
- Under Attack mode tested and verified

name: DEV-004 - CI/CD Pipeline (GitHub Actions)
Description:
Set up GitHub Actions pipelines for automated testing, Docker image building, and deployment to DOKS. Expectation: Zero-downtime automated deployments.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Pipeline runs unit/integration tests on every Pull Request
- On merge to main, pipeline builds Docker images and pushes to DO Container Registry
- Automated Helm or Kustomize deployment to Staging environment
- Manual approval gate for Production deployments

name: DEV-005 - Kubernetes Secrets & RBAC Management
Description:
Implement secure secret management and Role-Based Access Control in K8s. Expectation: No hardcoded secrets; strict least-privilege access.

Acceptance Criteria:
- External Secrets Operator or HashiCorp Vault deployed
- Environment variables (DB credentials, API keys) injected securely into pods
- K8s RBAC configured (e.g., developers have read-only access to prod cluster)
- Network Policies restrict ingress/egress between namespaces

name: DEV-006 - Automated Load & Stress Testing Bots
Description:
Build headless bot scripts (k6 or Playwright) to simulate hundreds of concurrent users joining a meeting room (Volume 7). Expectation: Validation of auto-scaling triggers.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Bot script can spawn 500+ headless browser instances joining a specific room
- Simulates WebRTC media transmission (dummy audio/video tracks)
- Validates that DOKS cluster successfully spins up new nodes when CPU/Memory thresholds are met
- Generates load test performance report

name: DEV-007 - Automated Penetration & Vulnerability Scanners
Description:
Integrate automated security scanning tools (e.g., OWASP ZAP, Trivy) into the CI pipeline (Volume 10). Expectation: Continuous security auditing.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Trivy scans Docker images for CVEs before deployment
- Automated DAST (Dynamic Application Security Testing) runs against Staging on a weekly schedule
- Security alerts fail the build if CRITICAL vulnerabilities are found
- Reports are sent to the engineering Slack/Discord channel

name: DEV-008 - Observability
start Date:
Deploy a centralized logging and monitoring stack (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Loki). Expectation: Deep visibility into system health.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Prometheus scraping metrics from K8s nodes, Postgres, Redis, and WebRTC servers
- Grafana dashboards visualizing CPU, Memory, API latency, and active WebRTC connections
- Centralized log aggregation (Loki or ELK) for searching application logs
- PagerDuty/Slack alerts configured for high CPU, high error rates, or DB failovers
